cited_share.entity: industry — global EV battery usage, all chemistries (CATL, BYD, LGES, CALB, Gotion, Panasonic, EVE, SK On, SVOLT, REPT)
cited_share.metric: Global EV/PHEV/HEV battery usage (batteries in vehicles registered worldwide) and supplier market share
cited_share.value: Total 725.2 GWh, +20.4% YoY (July alone 116.0 GWh, +22.1%). CATL 289.6 GWh / 39.9% share (+26.6% YoY; share 38.0%→39.9%); BYD 106.7 GWh / 14.7% (+4.7%; 16.9%→14.7%); LG Energy Solution 60.3 GWh / 8.3% (+4.5%; 9.6%→8.3%); CALB 37.3 GWh (+34.3%); Gotion 34.0 GWh (+44.2%); Panasonic 26.2 GWh / 3.6% (+7.6%; 4.0%→3.6%); EVE 25.0 GWh (+53.1%); SK On 22.3 GWh / 3.1% (−9.8%; 4.1%→3.1%); SVOLT 18.9 GWh (+39.1%); REPT 16.9 GWh (+118.5%, new entrant displacing Sunwoda). Seven Chinese suppliers in the top 10 = 72.8% combined (+3.1pp). CATL+BYD combined SHARE 54.6% (−0.3pp from 54.9%). LFP share of global usage 51.6%→56.1%; average pack size 34.5→38.6 kWh.
cited_share.source_name: SNE Research — Press Release (Insight), "From Jan to Jul 2026, Global EV Battery Usage Posted 725.2GWh" (English edition; data from its Global EV and Battery Monthly Tracker, August 2026)
cited_share.caveat: Every battery chemistry in use today, not solid-state: no part of this can be read across to solid-state share. It is here as the backdrop the solid-state race is being run against.

cited_share.entity: industry — global EV battery usage EXCLUDING China (CATL, LGES, BYD, Panasonic, SK On, Samsung SDI, Gotion, SVOLT, CALB, EVE)
cited_share.metric: Global (ex-China) EV/PHEV/HEV battery usage and supplier market share
cited_share.source_name: SNE Research — Press Release (Insight), "Global (Ex-China) EV Battery Usage in January-July 2026 Reaches 316.2 GWh, Up 25.8% Year-on-Year"
cited_share.caveat: Also every chemistry, not solid-state. It is the more honest denominator for the Korean and Japanese makers, whose combined share fell 10.4 points over the year.

shipments.metric: Composition of the cumulative LCB cell count — largest single customer application
shipments.value: more than 175 repeat orders and cumulative deliveries exceeding 900,000 cells to one U.S. automotive audio-system customer
shipments.source_name: ProLogium Technology press release, "ProLogium Begins Mass Production of High-Energy-Density All-Solid-State Battery…"
shipments.caveat: The largest single use of these cells is a car audio system, not vehicle propulsion, so the cumulative count is not a count of EV traction cells.

shipments.value: None disclosed — no GWh and no cell count. Customer samples and prototypes only: B0 samples of QSE-5 in 2024, B1 prototypes in 2025, and in 2026 QSE-5 cells to an additional automotive OEM and to a U.S. defense prime. The Eagle line in San Jose is a pilot line.
shipments.unit: none disclosed (no GWh, no unit count)
shipments.source_name: QuantumScape Corporation, Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended June 30, 2026 (SEC EDGAR)
shipments.caveat: The largest listed pure play has never disclosed a shipment volume of any kind. What has left the building is customer samples from a pilot line.

shipments.entity: ProLogium Technology 輝能科技 — Taoyuan gigafactory (Taiwan)
shipments.metric: Cells delivered from the third-generation Giga-level platform since it entered operation
shipments.value: more than 600,000 cells delivered; the line has been operational since 2024
shipments.source_name: ProLogium Technology press release, "ProLogium Breaks Ground on Dunkirk Gigafactory in France"
shipments.caveat: A count for one plant since 2024, on a different basis from the company's cumulative platform total since 2013 — the two numbers are not comparable and neither is a GWh figure.

shipments.entity: ProLogium Technology 輝能科技 (Taiwan; unlisted)
shipments.metric: Cumulative cells shipped on the Lithium Ceramic Battery (LCB) platform since commercial production began
shipments.period: 2013 to date; the same '>2.4 million' floor was first published for H1 2025 and restated unchanged on 2026-09-02
shipments.source_name: ProLogium Technology press release, "ProLogium Begins Mass Production of High-Energy-Density All-Solid-State Battery, Reaching 381 Wh/kg and 903 Wh/L"
shipments.caveat: A company-stated floor, not a measured total, and the same floor ProLogium published for the first half of 2025 — so it understates whatever has shipped since. These are not EV traction cells.

capacity.metric: First all-solid-state (GEMSTONE / 金石) pilot production line, design capacity
capacity.value: 0.2 GWh pilot production line completed, running at a 90% yield rate
capacity.period: announced 2025-05-20 at Gotion's Global Technology Conference 2025
capacity.source_name: Gotion High-Tech press release, "Gotion Completing the First 0.2GWh Pilot Line for All-Solid-State Batteries" (PR Newswire, issued by the company)
capacity.caveat: A pilot line, and still the largest all-solid-state line any listed company in this file has said is built. The semi-solid line announced in the same release is sixty times bigger.

capacity.entity: Solid Power, Inc. (NASDAQ: SLDP) — SP2, Thornton, Colorado
capacity.metric: Sulfide electrolyte production capacity (the company's product is electrolyte, not cells)
capacity.value: "Currently 2 pilot electrolyte manufacturing lines with capacity of 30MT per year"; "Plan to grow capacity to 75MT per year by end of 2026 by installing continuous manufacturing pilot line"
capacity.unit: metric tons per year of electrolyte (no GWh disclosed)
capacity.period: 30 MT/yr as at May 2026; 75 MT/yr targeted for end-2026
capacity.source_name: Solid Power, Inc., investor overview, Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K (SEC EDGAR)
capacity.caveat: Tonnes of electrolyte, not gigawatt-hours of cells — Solid Power sells the material rather than the battery, so its capacity cannot be added to anyone else's.

capacity.metric: Chengdu all-solid-state mass-production base, phased annual capacity
capacity.value: phase one completed December 2025 with 60Ah cell manufacturing capability; phase two planned to deliver 100 MWh of annual capacity in December 2026. Site area about 11,000 m², close to 500,000 cells a year once fully in production.
capacity.period: phase one December 2025; phase two December 2026
capacity.source_name: 亿纬锂能 EVE Energy company newsroom, 「亿纬锂能固态电池成都量产基地揭牌，全固态电池商业化迈出关键一步」
capacity.caveat: 100 MWh is 0.1 GWh, and the cells are aimed at humanoid robots, drones and AI equipment rather than cars.

capacity.entity: ProLogium Technology 輝能科技 — Dunkirk, France
capacity.metric: Announced staging of the Dunkirk gigafactory, as set out at groundbreaking
capacity.value: 2028: Fab 1, Phase 1 completed, start of Gen4 mass production (0.8 GWh); 2029: capacity ramp-up; 2030: Fab 1, Phase 2 completed, full operation at 4 GWh; 2032: Phase 2 completed, total capacity reaches 12 GWh. Long term, and in line with market demand, the site has the potential to scale progressively to 48 GWh.
capacity.period: 2028 to 2032, with a long-term 48 GWh potential
capacity.source_name: ProLogium Technology press release, "ProLogium Breaks Ground on Dunkirk Gigafactory in France"
capacity.caveat: Construction started in February 2026 and the first 0.8 GWh is dated 2028, so nothing in this row is producing today. ProLogium described the same first phase as 4.0 GWh seven months later — see the row below.

capacity.entity: 赣锋锂业 Ganfeng Lithium (002460.SZ) — GanfengLiEnergy, Xinyu, Jiangxi
capacity.metric: In-operation cell capacity at the Xinyu base, as stated by the company
capacity.value: 2 GWh of solid-state battery capacity and 7 GWh of lithium iron phosphate capacity
capacity.source_name: Ganfeng Lithium company news, "Chongqing GanfengLiEnergy Industrial Park starts construction, planning to build the largest solid-state battery production base in China"
capacity.caveat: Ganfeng's "solid-state" cells are hybrid solid-liquid, and this is the most recent capacity figure the company has published — it is nearly three years old.

capacity.entity: ProLogium Technology 輝能科技 — Dunkirk, France
capacity.metric: Dunkirk first-phase annual capacity, as restated in September 2026
capacity.value: "Upon completion of the first phase, the facility is designed to reach 4.0 GWh of annual production capacity"
capacity.period: first phase; no completion year given in this release
capacity.source_name: ProLogium Technology press release, "ProLogium Begins Mass Production of High-Energy-Density All-Solid-State Battery, Reaching 381 Wh/kg and 903 Wh/L"
capacity.caveat: The company's February release put 0.8 GWh in 2028 and only reached 4 GWh in 2030. Both figures are recorded because ProLogium published both; neither is reconciled anywhere.

capacity.metric: G-Yuan quasi-solid-state (semi-solid) cell production line under construction
capacity.value: a 12 GWh production line currently under construction
capacity.source_name: Gotion High-Tech press release, "Gotion Completing the First 0.2GWh Pilot Line for All-Solid-State Batteries" (PR Newswire, issued by the company)
capacity.caveat: Semi-solid, not all-solid-state — which is why it is sixty times the size of the all-solid-state pilot line Gotion announced in the same release. No site and no start year are given.
capacity.start_year: not stated; under construction as at 2025-05-20
